identity_rules: EK identifiers identify works; titles are not unique.
Do not fabricate a painting for every integer between EK 1 and EK 1088: the sequence includes reliefs, sculpture and fractional identifiers.
Keep all sourced works in the research ledger. Default display may retain only earliest exact normalized-title match at user request.
Do not strip Roman numerals, color-word order, parenthetical dedications, Chatham numbers, or relief/panel/curve qualifiers from identity.
Preserve Unsigned/Untitled as meaningful placeholder titles; never assume every work titled Untitled depicts the same composition.
Unknown collection means unknown; private collection is sourced anonymous ownership, not unknown.
Collection statements are as recorded by source on retrieval date, not independently confirmed live ownership.
